adoration.text: Adoration room open 06:00 to 22:15 daily (closed every Wednesday 10:00-12:00 for cleaning).

confession.text: 30 mins before Weekend Mass in the Main Church.

devotions.text: Rosary Prayers: Mon to Fri at 17:15 in the Main Church.
Divine Mercy Devotion: every Tue at 18:45 in the Main Church.
Christian Meditation: every Wed at 20:00 in St John/St Luke room.
Liturgy of the Word for Children: every 2nd & 4th Sunday at the 10:30 Mass.
Holy Hour and Devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus: Friday, 4 Dec, after the 18:00 evening Mass.

good_to_know.text: Weekday Mass on a Public holiday is at 08:00 only.
Standing along the aisles is not permitted during Mass and services.

events.title: Lead Like Jesus (LLJ)
events.text: A foundational leadership module that focuses on heart-centred, transformative leadership grounded in the teachings of Jesus Christ, emphasising servant leadership, integrity, and compassion.
